findings.evidence: Grep of code/TauCeti for cliffordSphere, sphereTangentDiffeomorphOfOrthonormal and orthogonalProjSphere finds nothing. Glob of CliffordAlgebra/Module/ finds only Basic, Euclidean and Metric. Sphere/Parallelizable.lean on main already has exists_orthonormal_contMDiff_sphere_tangentFrame and nonempty_sphere_tangentBundle_diffeomorph for n ∈ {0,1,3,7}. The posDef theorem in the diff is TauCeti.exists_posDef_quadraticForm, not QuadraticForm.exists_posDef.
findings.fix: Rewrite the description to state only what the diff adds: the generalised TauCeti.exists_posDef_quadraticForm, QuadraticMap.PosDef.exists_linearEquiv_norm_sq_eq, Sphere/TangentBundle.lean, and IsLocalFrameOn.of_linearIndependent, of_orthonormal and toOrthonormalBasisAt. Drop the claims about parallelizability and about what remains for sphere_parallelizable_iff, and fix the declaration names in the quality-pass block.
findings.issue: The description says this PR builds the Clifford sphere frames and proves parallelizability of S⁰, S¹, S³ and S⁷, and that afterwards only the converse remains for sphere_parallelizable_iff. The diff contains none of that: cliffordSphereFrame, cliffordSphereTangentDiffeomorph, sphereTangentDiffeomorphOfOrthonormal, Orthonormal.sphereTangentOrthonormalBasis, isLocalFrameOn_univ_sphere_of_orthonormal, exists_orthonormal_contMDiff_sphere_of_mem, LinearMap.BilinForm.exists_linearEquiv_inner_eq, QuadraticForm.exists_posDef, exists_isSkewAdjoint_inner_realCliffordForm_zero and the file CliffordAlgebra/Module/InnerProduct.lean are all absent. Parallelizability is already on main in Sphere/Parallelizable.lean.

summary: The new statements in the diff (posDef generalisation, norm-square realisation, sphere tangential projection and lifts, the (ℝ ∙ x)ᗮ subbundle and its diffeomorphism with TSⁿ, the TSⁿ ⊕ ε¹ ≅ εⁿ⁺¹ splitting, and the local-frame constructors) are faithful. The PR description, however, claims results and declarations that are not in the diff.
